notes: 10-K for 1998, plain text. Items 1 to 14 (pre-2003 numbering), one heading each. Item 7A is listed absent: it applied to fiscal 1998 and the document has no market risk heading or text at all. An unnumbered 'EXECUTIVE OFFICERS OF AMF BOWLING' section follows Item 4's 'None.' and stays in Item 4, so Item 4 is not marked incorporated. Item 8 prints the full statements (1613 to 4779). Item 14 runs through the exhibit list and its footnotes to SIGNATURES (5061). Marked incorporated: Items 10 to 13 (proxy statement). Size: the cover says non-affiliates held shares worth $69.4 million, which put this filing in the small slot although AMF Bowling was a large business.
